name: prebuilt/person-to-phone-batch
description: Find mobile phone numbers for a CSV of people in one pass.

csv.description: Runtime CSV input path supplied through plays run --input, for example {"csv":"leads.csv"}.

columns.description: Optional CSV header aliases keyed by canonical play input field.

rows.description: Durable row dataset. Each row preserves the original CSV columns and adds a phone column.

phone.description: Resolved phone number, or null if none was found.

phone_source.description: Waterfall step that produced the resolved phone.

phone_validated.description: True when the final phone passed Trestle validation before being returned.

phone_validation_status.description: Trestle validation status for the returned phone.

phone_activity_score.description: Trestle activity score for the returned phone, when provided.

phone_activity_band.description: Derived activity band: active, risky, stale, unknown, or null.

phone_line_type.description: Trestle line type for the returned phone, when provided.

phone_carrier.description: Trestle carrier for the returned phone, when provided.

phone_reject_reason.description: Reason a returned phone was rejected, if any.

flowchart TD

phones --> loop

end
loop --> out["Return enriched rows"]
